name: Motor Scooter
description: A motor-driven cycle with a motor rated at no more than 4.9 horsepower and a top speed of 30 mph, the scooter counterpart of a motorized bicycle. An electric two-wheeler past an electric motorized bicycle's limits that rides like a scooter rather than a bicycle lands here while it stays within these limits.

restrictions.rule: A motor-driven cycle: a saddle the rider sits astride and no more than three wheels on the ground
Its motor is rated at no more than 4.9 horsepower (about 3,675 W); the statute's 50 cc cap is a combustion-engine measure
Riders need a valid driver's license and must be 16 or older; exempt from the motorcycle license
Riders must wear approved eye protection, and riders under 21 an approved helmet
Registered with the DMV as a motor scooter
One faster than 30 mph or with a motor over 4.9 horsepower is a motor-driven cycle or a motorcycle, which needs a motorcycle license
